name: gfx_sync
doc: An NVN sync object, kept inside the guest's NVNsync (src/gfx/sync.ts; nxnative sync_t.fenced and fence). The pending states carry the fence number they wait for: PendingFence from nvnQueueFenceSync, PendingAcquire from nvnWindowAcquireTexture. Complete is nvnSyncWait finding the fence done (gfx_fence_done). A fenced sync is fenced again through Reset.
